origin: row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge; rows increase to the south
slope_note: central difference over 2 regional cells (10 m)

relation_to_1km_grid.model: col_1km = col_reg * scale + col_offset ; row_1km = row_reg * scale + row_offset  (cell-corner coordinates; for cell centres use (c+0.5)*scale+offset-0.5)
relation_to_1km_grid.note: 1 km grid px = 1 DTM px, so offsets are exact integers (DTM px); regional cell = block mean of K x K DTM px
